Bind principals to authentication, validate base revisions, deduplicate stable operation IDs, retain pending/rejected proposals and return explicit conflicts. Git, SQLite file copying and CRDT text merges cannot bypass domain invariants.

bd186e65-ccd7-5720-abd2-1c75c67da7f6.title: Explicit stage authorization
bd186e65-ccd7-5720-abd2-1c75c67da7f6.statement: This seed is planning only. Broad roadmap entries, provisional estimates and existing source references are not execution authorization, completed work or release evidence.

2493971c-2616-5deb-b3a6-750e7d826522.title: Repository-independent workspace identity
2493971c-2616-5deb-b3a6-750e7d826522.statement: A workspace is one validated graph containing nested projects and code or non-code tasks. Stable workspace, project and task IDs survive checkout moves and repository renames; cross-project edges are validated together. Work-package containment stays within its project.

ab68d6d6-0145-554f-980b-c5bb2bd4514b.title: Portable resource references and local bindings
ab68d6d6-0145-554f-980b-c5bb2bd4514b.statement: Tasks may reference zero, one or multiple resources. Shared resource IDs are independent of remote URLs and device-local checkout paths. Explicit locators select one workspace across repositories; ambiguous bindings fail and context filters are visible. Resource references do not count as completion evidence.

2d5a1316-0b52-5ddc-aecc-23d92a73ec8b.title: Lossless versioned plan interchange
2d5a1316-0b52-5ddc-aecc-23d92a73ec8b.statement: TOML and JSON encode the same versioned interchange model independently of locator, API and storage schemas. Preserve supported authoritative values and IDs; exclude derived views, credentials and local bindings. Import validates and proposes changes at an observed revision without replacing live history or bypassing lifecycle verification. Before publication, migrate bundled inputs directly to the selected format rather than retaining legacy adapters; unsupported formats fail explicitly and live databases are never silently replaced.

c79a01b2-9102-5dce-9b1b-f67d67972424.title: Durable operational state and recovery
c79a01b2-9102-5dce-9b1b-f67d67972424.statement: SQLite holds durable standalone state or a collaborative replica with pending operations. Text exports may be stale and omit history; startup never rebuilds live state from them. Recovery preserves checkpoints, operation lineage and unsent work; active database files are not a file-sync protocol.

2202b173-92fd-52d8-a2a2-d94275a7a48f.title: Decisions consumed with work
2202b173-92fd-52d8-a2a2-d94275a7a48f.statement: Explain returns relevant requirements and decisions with their rationale, source and status. Context associations do not gate execution. Reviewed decision replacement preserves prior rationale and identifies affected work for reassessment; source discussion or a recorded choice is not implementation or execution authorization.

7a271ec4-eda0-58d2-8f6f-b2b11d72bf88.title: Implementation and acceptance have separate evidence
7a271ec4-eda0-58d2-8f6f-b2b11d72bf88.statement: A source revision and its implementation/tests establish what can be qualified. Only actual task operations and independent acceptance establish executed progress. Reconciliation preserves IDs and history, identifies residual work, and leaves re-scoped work unestimated until assessed. A prepared preview never fabricates a live cycle.

7d087933-d116-5cc5-9551-119fe84a81e0.title: Observable agent execution
7d087933-d116-5cc5-9551-119fe84a81e0.statement: A run links work, executor, source/configuration and contract revision to durable lifecycle facts and a separately sequenced activity feed. Tool output and heartbeats do not advance project revision or imply acceptance. Unsupported external sessions are labelled as reported-only; reconnect, loss and stale activity are explicit.

59030fe0-202e-551c-a7ab-480c74796f55.title: Recoverable and time-aware views
59030fe0-202e-551c-a7ab-480c74796f55.statement: A view identifies workspace, lineage, revision, evaluation time and feed cursor. Snapshot-to-subscription handover loses no committed changes. Duplicate delivery, gaps and slow consumers recover explicitly; elapsed lag and stale-run state refresh without requiring a new project revision.

ee044f38-e9bc-59d0-818b-ddccf6ce69be.title: Local native observation first
ee044f38-e9bc-59d0-818b-ddccf6ce69be.statement: The macOS Now, Live, Review and Detail views use the shared application boundary. A local observation release does not require hosted sync, a terminal redesign, configuration management or steering. Swift UI state is a projection; local process I/O stays off the UI thread. The existing read-only preview remains usable.

89632adf-2f8c-558f-ade5-bef91823ac14.title: Attributed and acknowledged control
89632adf-2f8c-558f-ade5-bef91823ac14.statement: Run control binds an authorized stable principal to a specific run and turn. Queue, steer, interrupt and contract change have distinct semantics and durable request/result identities. Receipt is not execution, stopping is not rollback, and a provider capability cannot bypass task acceptance or the approved tool/workspace scope.

9eed496f-07b1-538e-b47c-d733b075cd10.title: Versioned configuration and verification
9eed496f-07b1-538e-b47c-d733b075cd10.statement: Configuration items and immutable revisions form explicit baselines. Test executions bind procedure revision, exact configuration, result and evidence to requirement revisions. Configuration changes retain historical passes and derive affected or unknown validity pending review. A plan baseline, current forecast and actual event record are distinct from a product configuration baseline.

04fd671f-dd16-595d-94f2-b7c5d59426a0.title: Traceable engineering changes
04fd671f-dd16-595d-94f2-b7c5d59426a0.statement: External observations retain provider identity, source version and observation time. Inferred impacts are proposals until reviewed. The typed project graph can describe rework and supersession while temporal dependencies between concrete attempts remain acyclic. Risk-event scenarios, capacity constraints and procurement facts remain explicit inputs rather than hidden duration padding.

c49ffca1-1b01-5e2b-9954-18971c07312e.question: When has the user explicitly authorized starting the self-host tasks? This prepared seed must remain query-only until that separate instruction.

a7fb9363-39af-5e46-a1a1-2b05baa9fff4.question: Which source commit, operational workspace and independent reviewer are explicitly selected for the live self-host cycle and publication evidence?

a62796ee-1095-5fea-b048-0335309c39b5.question: Which later terminal layout scope is explicitly accepted after the MVP review? No layout work is authorized by this seed.

f1751454-e429-554c-add8-96aca3db1998.question: Are the execution-semantics contracts (WP-8) and their prerequisites CORE-20 and SCH-10 approved as MVP scope? Later phases stay gated by DEC-POST-MVP; server/sync/auth and native UI remain deferred.

7d520a23-dcd3-5334-b325-7c385cfe2ca1.question: How do projects spanning repositories and non-code work share state?
7d520a23-dcd3-5334-b325-7c385cfe2ca1.outcome: Use one workspace graph with multiple entry points. Repository/resource identity is separate from local bindings; Git discovery boundaries remain conservative.
7d520a23-dcd3-5334-b325-7c385cfe2ca1.rationale: Checkout layout differs between users and must not fragment project dependencies or create independent writable copies of the same workspace.

6b66a3f5-abe1-5d84-9b98-0bcc5a5ed9ae.question: What role do TOML and JSON have relative to operational state?
6b66a3f5-abe1-5d84-9b98-0bcc5a5ed9ae.outcome: Use TOML for human plan interchange and JSON for the same machine model. Keep locator configuration separate; apply imported edits as validated semantic proposals.
6b66a3f5-abe1-5d84-9b98-0bcc5a5ed9ae.rationale: Reviewable text is useful for sharing, but an edited or stale export cannot safely overwrite lifecycle, independent verification or operation history.

3e1bbddb-282e-5557-a40a-a00cd39c2298.question: Is SQLite a disposable hot copy of a plan file?
3e1bbddb-282e-5557-a40a-a00cd39c2298.outcome: Keep SQLite as durable local operational storage, including pending work in collaborative mode. Use consistent backups for recovery and semantic operations for synchronization.
3e1bbddb-282e-5557-a40a-a00cd39c2298.rationale: The latest committed or unsent actions can exist only in the local store; neither an older text snapshot nor copying a live main database file preserves that record.

b76b00cd-d98c-5526-b73b-e30ebf17cff8.question: How should the first collaboration protocol order competing changes?
b76b00cd-d98c-5526-b73b-e30ebf17cff8.outcome: Use one logical sequencer per workspace, durable client outboxes and explicit revision conflicts. Offline claims are tentative until acknowledged; no automatic stale-command merge.
b76b00cd-d98c-5526-b73b-e30ebf17cff8.rationale: Equal numeric revisions can have different histories, and disconnected agents cannot guarantee exclusive ownership. Conservative validation gives a testable first protocol without mandatory SaaS.

946a3b57-6bf1-52c9-a2d6-b26f77a92592.question: Where should durable planning choices be consumed?
946a3b57-6bf1-52c9-a2d6-b26f77a92592.outcome: Store constraints and concise choices in linked requirements/decisions; put future work in task contracts and implementation evidence in artifacts. Read them through explain rather than a parallel narrative plan.
946a3b57-6bf1-52c9-a2d6-b26f77a92592.rationale: A decision needs an execution-time reader, scope and replacement handling; changing a prose document into a different file format does not keep it current.

b95aafa9-a1f7-5544-8087-4922104c74e0.question: Which phases after M0-MVP acceptance are approved: format/TOML interchange and revert, calendars and milestone risk, alpha qualification, collaboration and projection designs? Nothing beyond the MVP is authorized by this seed.

72d89401-5244-5f4b-bb15-fac9c791ea22.question: How should operation schema/replay compatibility, stable principal/device attribution and a transport cursor extend the workspace/lineage, UUIDv7 and revision fields implemented by the local store?

c880941a-bed2-5235-91ec-00a45e9a8c94.question: How do operations record an authenticated principal with a stable id beside the claimed actor, so renames and credentials never split one person and independence checks compare principals?

b5a016e6-100a-50a8-836d-c4ba29630f9e.question: Beyond implemented IANA working calendars and working-time lags, which explicit project starts, milestone deadlines, date constraints, percent lags and summary links are required before publication, and how do they preserve input units and execution gates?

296d0b8a-bf96-551d-ac52-68a13afa4f2c.question: Is a portfolio one plan with nested projects or many plans with stable cross-plan references?

88a4e6fd-59eb-53df-8447-525e72806a54.question: Which provider adapters supply immutable external IDs, aliases and versioned observations to the implemented provider-scoped reference model, and how are conflicting external facts proposed for review?

e2daf98d-1ac3-5cee-8688-23a59a821d6f.question: Which local bridge and run-observation scope are approved for the macOS maintenance pilot: persistent Rust helper or FFI, and which provider supplies the first real event trace?
e2daf98d-1ac3-5cee-8688-23a59a821d6f.rationale: The proposed starting point is a persistent local Rust helper using dpm-app plus one provider adapter. UI-10 prepares the concrete Swift boundary and lifecycle comparison for review; this decision gates bridge and provider implementation. Hosted sync and terminal layout are independent work.

76b38b29-703b-5bd1-878e-3eeb31199207.question: Which queue, steer and interrupt semantics, principal permissions and acknowledgement guarantees are approved for the selected provider?
76b38b29-703b-5bd1-878e-3eeb31199207.rationale: Control is proposed after observable execution. Capability negotiation and explicit uncertain outcomes prevent unsupported pause, exactly-once delivery or rollback promises.

be268cf2-bc3e-5830-9fd5-60349a852a13.question: Which minimal item/revision/baseline and requirement/procedure/test identities demonstrate configuration-bound verification before broader PLM or procurement features?
be268cf2-bc3e-5830-9fd5-60349a852a13.rationale: The maintenance scenario pins software source/build inputs first; a PCB/firmware example checks domain generality. Historical results stay immutable and validity for another configuration requires review.

b8635851-d522-5bb0-b6f2-f757fb213481.question: After configuration-bound verification, which real procurement, facility-capacity and discrete rework-risk scenario should extend the graph and planning engine first?
b8635851-d522-5bb0-b6f2-f757fb213481.rationale: Review one physical delivery case before introducing BOM/supplier/PO/inventory records, resource-constrained optimization or correlated stochastic branches. Separate planned commitments, forecasts, actuals and explicit buffers; prefer source-system observations with provenance over a parallel ERP.

6ef69bbe-d99a-52fb-a141-c459bd0c3e8e.description: A broad reference roadmap may be mistaken for permission to implement deferred features.
6ef69bbe-d99a-52fb-a141-c459bd0c3e8e.mitigation: Keep DEC-EXECUTE and phase gates open; do not interpret planning data or estimates as authorization.

b683bb26-0d39-52e9-a283-6b2c93dcc082.description: Uncommitted MVP source or local check reports may be misrepresented as independently verified/public release evidence.
b683bb26-0d39-52e9-a283-6b2c93dcc082.mitigation: Distinguish contextual source artifacts from acceptance evidence; establish a real commit and independent review.

cf654136-d86c-5ad9-99e2-2dd5b817fe88.description: A requested task/dependency edit or recovery workflow may exceed the operations exposed by the installed version.
cf654136-d86c-5ad9-99e2-2dd5b817fe88.mitigation: Keep this seed reviewable. Do not overwrite live SQLite; use separately approved validated copies for plan authoring until CORE-20/30 are accepted.

56dcce46-6933-5a78-ab22-618ae1133687.description: Provisional O/M/P values and elapsed-hour projections may be mistaken for calendar commitments or resource-leveled dates.
56dcce46-6933-5a78-ab22-618ae1133687.mitigation: Re-estimate before execution; show units and uncertainty. No capacity, calendar or delivery promise is implied.

ad10cfce-3f4f-5646-8cd5-c1c1369eb84f.description: Local actor names can be impersonated and do not provide authenticated independent review.
ad10cfce-3f4f-5646-8cd5-c1c1369eb84f.mitigation: Use trusted separate reviewer processes now; add explicit credential/authorization boundaries only in the approved later scope.

6b3a76c5-47ad-566c-895b-b5635a7b30ce.description: An observer can confuse missing telemetry, provider completion or a delivered control request with accepted work.
6b3a76c5-47ad-566c-895b-b5635a7b30ce.mitigation: Keep project and run lifecycles separate; expose freshness, gaps, provider capabilities and acknowledgements.

836093cb-d487-55a5-b68e-12b663f71c83.description: A test pass can be reused against a different configuration or requirement revision without a valid basis.
836093cb-d487-55a5-b68e-12b663f71c83.mitigation: Bind tests to immutable inputs and derive affected/unknown validity; require explicit revalidation.

6da5342f-5ba2-53cc-969b-008932a5daf1.description: Source implementation or synthetic regression success can be mistaken for a real self-host acceptance record.
6da5342f-5ba2-53cc-969b-008932a5daf1.mitigation: Pin source context, retain missing evidence and leave live acceptance to independent recorded operations.
